suite_status: Initial automated suite. Passing these cases does not replace manual OAuth acceptance or prove full evaluation.

evals.name: mixed-trackers
evals.prompt: Plan a local Codex setup for Roster in Linear, HopperX in Linear, and Dock411 in Jira. No configuration has been changed yet. Do not run OAuth or edit files. Return the proposed map, safe setup sequence, and final report shape.
evals.expected_output: A plan with named Linear servers for Roster and HopperX, no Linear server for Dock411, user-controlled OAuth, read-only verification, write approval, and explicit Jira routing.
assertions: The plan proposes a named Linear MCP connection for Roster.
The plan proposes a named Linear MCP connection for HopperX.
The plan does not propose a Linear MCP connection for Dock411.
Dock411 is explicitly routed to Jira.
The plan does not inspect or request credential contents.
The plan does not perform or claim completion of OAuth.

evals.name: missing-get-workspace
evals.prompt: Audit a generic local MCP client's two named Linear connections. The client exposes list_teams but has no get_workspace tool. linear-roster returns [Roster App]. linear-personal returns [SWD-Projects]. The user confirms those team lists look right. Do not write data or change configuration. Report what is and is not proven.
evals.expected_output: The complete team lists are recorded and user-confirmed, but workspace identity and credential isolation remain unverified because no stable workspace identifier is available.
assertions: The output records both complete team lists.
The output notes the user's confirmation.
Workspace identity is marked unverified.
Credential isolation is marked unverified.
Team names are not treated as proof of workspace identity.
The setup is not declared fully verified or proven.
Compatibility with the generic MCP client is explicitly marked unverified.

evals.name: collapsed-credentials
evals.prompt: Audit two Claude Code MCP servers. linear-roster returns workspace ID 890f20af with name Roster App. After authenticating linear-hopperx, both linear-roster and linear-hopperx return workspace ID a16dc133 with name HopperAI. No writes have happened. Explain the next action and provide the audit result.
evals.expected_output: The audit fails, stops before writes, reports that the earlier connection changed and both names now share one identity, and recommends separate authentication contexts such as distinct MCP_REMOTE_CONFIG_DIR paths where supported.
assertions: The output identifies that linear-roster changed from its original workspace ID.
The output identifies that both server names now resolve to the same workspace ID.
The agent stops before any Linear write.
The setup is reported as failed or not isolated.
The recommendation uses separate authentication contexts.
MCP_REMOTE_CONFIG_DIR is described as a documented fallback, not as functionality implemented by the skill.

evals.name: unknown-workspace-count
evals.prompt: I use Linear for a few work areas but I do not know how many workspaces I can access or their exact names. Help me plan setup for Codex. Do not inspect browser sessions, change configuration, or start OAuth. Explain what you need from me and how you would proceed if I still cannot give a complete list.
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes accessible workspaces from desired workspaces, asks which work areas and trackers the user wants, asks the user to check Linear's workspace switcher, does not infer a count, and offers one-row incremental planning before each OAuth as a fallback.
assertions: The output states or makes clear that it cannot reliably enumerate every Linear workspace in the user's account.
The output asks which work areas the user wants the agent to access and which tracker each one uses.
The output suggests that the user check Linear's workspace switcher for exact names.
The output does not infer the desired workspace count from existing MCP connections or team names.
The output offers an incremental one-work-area-at-a-time fallback if the user cannot provide a complete list.
The output requires confirmation of at least the next planned connection before OAuth or configuration.
The output requires a final cumulative map before routing guidance is installed.

evals.name: missing-disabled-transport
evals.prompt: A repo disables linear-hopperx with an enabled=false entry, but global config has no linear-hopperx definition. Codex reports invalid transport. Diagnose without changing files or starting OAuth.
evals.expected_output: Reject the incomplete merged connection, repair the confirmed transport before scoping, and avoid repeated login.
assertions: The disabled server is recognized as needing a complete transport.
The agent stops before writing new repo overrides.
The agent does not guess a workspace alias or start OAuth.
The plan checks parsing in both unscoped and affected repo contexts.

evals.name: replacement-fails
evals.prompt: Plan replacing an existing Codex Linear bridge used by three repo overrides. Verification fails after the replacement. Do not edit files or run OAuth. Include recovery and what happens if another process edits config.
evals.expected_output: Prepare and atomically replace the complete definition, preserve approval, restore config on failure without overwriting concurrent edits, and distinguish config rollback from credentials.
assertions: The plan never removes the global server before replacement.
The complete transport and writes approval are present together.
Global connections remain disabled by default; verification enables them only in its process.
Failure restores prior config only if another process has not changed it.
The plan does not claim config rollback restores OAuth credentials.

evals.name: remote-plugin-enabled
evals.prompt: A fresh codex plugin list --json returns installed=[{pluginId: "linear@openai-curated", enabled:false}, {pluginId:"linear@openai-curated-remote", enabled:true}]. Config says both are false and the named server reaches the correct workspace. Can Linear writes proceed? Do not change files.
evals.expected_output: Reject plugin verification, keep writes paused, and direct the user to disable the actual installed plugin through /plugins and recheck.
assertions: The enabled remote plugin is detected despite the disabled old ID.
Config false is not accepted as installed-state proof.
Linear writes stay paused.
The agent does not repeat OAuth or rename connections.

evals.name: unreadable-plugin-state
evals.prompt: The named Linear server reaches the exact expected workspace ID, but a fresh plugin list command fails or returns an unknown JSON shape. Report whether setup is fully verified. Do not edit files.
evals.expected_output: Report workspace identity as verified but plugin state as unverified, keep writes paused, and require a fresh successful installed-state check.
assertions: Unknown plugin state is not treated as absent or disabled.
The agent does not report complete verification.
Linear writes stay paused.
